ed858324-c972-4d85-be4e-3287767eb7da.altTitle: Life Reversal: I was Cheated on and Falsely Accused, but Now the Most Beautiful Girl in the School is Getting Close to Me
ed858324-c972-4d85-be4e-3287767eb7da.description: Di penghujung musim panas, Aono Eiji menyaksikan kekasih sekaligus teman masa kecilnya, Amada Miyuki, berselingkuh dengan Kondou, ace dari klub sepak bola. Dikhianati oleh sang kekasih, Eiji yang sudah terpuruk harus menghadapi cercaan dan fitnah yang bertubi-tubi tanpa alasan yang jelas. Terdesak ke sudut, Eiji melarikan diri ke atap sekolah dan di sana ia bertemu dengan seorang gadis...

fe840243-5b68-447a-ab4b-c094eed7d6af.title: Jinhong ui Karma
fe840243-5b68-447a-ab4b-c094eed7d6af.description: Kasia del Roman is a soldier crafted to become an assassin. She lost her human emotions long ago and lived her life as a simple tool, just to be thrown away in her final moments. She couldn’t even die a proper death as she opened her eyes to a battlefield of a different world. Will she live the same life she did in her original world?

55a1aba6-967c-4967-a1d0-ad0f52332be0.title: The Baengri Clan's Unwanted Granddaughter
55a1aba6-967c-4967-a1d0-ad0f52332be0.altTitle: I Became the Despised Granddaughter of the Murim Clan
55a1aba6-967c-4967-a1d0-ad0f52332be0.description: Tragis. Hanya itu deskripsi yang tepat untuk hidup Yeon. Meski terlahir sebagai cucu kepala Klan Baekri yang hebat, itu tidak lantas membuat hidupnya mudah. Hinaan jadi makanan sehari-hari Yeon karena terlahir sebagai anak di luar nikah. Tidak hanya itu saja, tepat setelah sang ayah meninggal, Yeon dibunuh dengan keji. "Tolong aku!" Keajaiban terjadi. Begitu membuka mata, Yeon kembali ke masa lalu ketika ayahnya masih hidup. "Aku harus menyelamatkan ayah!" Inilah perjalanan Yeon mengubah takdir!

bd2565d1-b619-4201-90a6-102a47aeeb1a.title: Himegoto Kakushigoto
bd2565d1-b619-4201-90a6-102a47aeeb1a.description: The fact that he was an illegitimate child came to light after his father's death. Ueda Naoomi, who fled from home in shock, meets Fujisaki Yuzu, a girl who has also run away from home due to family troubles. Yuzu asks Naomi to cooperate in a staged kidnapping to make her family worry about her. During the time they spend together, they gradually fall in love, but at the end of their journey, a shocking fact is revealed...!?

5640514d-c2c3-4b4e-aef2-1f358f914cc8.title: Mahoutsukai no Yakusoku
5640514d-c2c3-4b4e-aef2-1f358f914cc8.description:
<when the wind feels strong and the cats are restless, in full moon nights.... Something strange could happen.>

Akira is a normal guy who gets transported to another world summoned by wizards who call him "Master Sage". This world is threatened by a strange happening called the "Great Catastrophe" and now Akira must leader the 21 unique and different wizards who fight against it while understanding their worries and connects with their hearts.
<I just want you to discover the truth of this world...>

5cb6e7dd-0fd8-4aab-be7c-5446b007f9bb.title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston - Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei Shita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Karei Naru Musouroku
5cb6e7dd-0fd8-4aab-be7c-5446b007f9bb.description:
"I wanted to die in battle."

There once was a great hero, capable of killing a god, who longed to fight even at the brink of death. What awaited her was her reincarnation as Nia Liston, a beautiful but sickly daughter of nobles in a future world. Now in her second life, she gets another chance to rampage in fights, dabble in broadcasting, and even experience academy life! Thus begin the epic battle records of a heroine who will one day be called the "The Merciless Maiden, Nia Liston"!

*Source: Manga UP! Global*

6f003727-741d-44aa-8c0f-9e4ec0055b9c.title: Dekai Usagi ni Natsukareta!?
6f003727-741d-44aa-8c0f-9e4ec0055b9c.altTitle: I Got Tamed by a Giant Rabbit!?
6f003727-741d-44aa-8c0f-9e4ec0055b9c.description: A new member of the workforce, the night before his first day... Hajime Ogami is so nervous he can’t sleep. Plagued by anxiety over whether he can make it in the distant, unfamiliar city of Fukuoka, Hajime heads out for a midnight stroll. There, he is accosted by a strangely over-familiar, "giant" drunk woman, and the two of them end up heading out into the "city at night" together...!?

0fc3e2d1-d07e-4230-a8ef-37dc9862c0a3.title: Fusuma Land 4.5
0fc3e2d1-d07e-4230-a8ef-37dc9862c0a3.description: Udagawa Kachiko is a studious no-nonsense high school girl. One day, she found an entrance to a fantastic world called Fusuma Land.

ba798310-2324-423a-be79-6c15713dd647.title: Xiang Yu & Liu Bang
ba798310-2324-423a-be79-6c15713dd647.altTitle: Xiang Yu and Liu Bang - The Young Lions -
ba798310-2324-423a-be79-6c15713dd647.description:
This manga covers the Chu-Han Contention period of China. During the final days of China's Qin Dynasty, Emperor Qin Shi Huang dreams of his eventual fall from power. Fearing the message of the dream, he travels China in search for an elixir of immortality. During all this, the Emperor's Legalist train of thought causes him to brutally crack down on those who opposed his policies by burning their books and burying scholars... Meanwhile, multiple individuals rise up, each fighting one another to become the face of China's next dynasty.

|| **Young Lions** was the original seriaization title, It was later changed to **Xiang Yu and Liu Bang** for the book release||

chapters.title: Burning of Books and Burying of Scholars

ed4a99cf-3cd7-41f5-9fd2-d69fe51a2f3c.title: Hero ga Jipchakhaneun Akdang i Doeeotda
ed4a99cf-3cd7-41f5-9fd2-d69fe51a2f3c.altTitle: I Became the Villain the Hero Is Obsessed With
ed4a99cf-3cd7-41f5-9fd2-d69fe51a2f3c.description:
Da-in, ended up possessing the villain of a story.

To make Stardust — the story's protagonist and his favorite character in a dystopian manga — happy, he resolves to become the villain Egoistic for her growth.

Da-in deliberately causes terror to enhance Stardust's abilities and preemptively prevents all the tragic events from the original story, but in the process, he gains public support while also drawing Stardust's suspicion.

Stardust, who initially opposed him, gradually opens her heart, and soon even begins to show signs of obsession towards him...?

032f800d-d632-4442-8830-d037d616ead4.title: Henkyou-gurashi no Maou, Tensei Shite Saikyou no Majutsushi ni Naru
032f800d-d632-4442-8830-d037d616ead4.altTitle: The Demon King of the Frontier Life, Reincarnated to Become the Strongest Mage
032f800d-d632-4442-8830-d037d616ead4.description:
There was once a mage called The Lone Demon King on the frontier. He was just a creature that never grew old, but was also loved by the villagers as something of a guardian deity. However, he was destroyed by a magic organization that sees his existence as dangerous. 200 years later, he is reincarnated as the second son of an aristocrat and obtains the strongest magic power.

"Let's pretend to be a human this time."

However, being a human lover, he didn't particularly think of revenge and has decided to pretend to be human in this life. In his past life, he was the guardian deity of a region, and in this life, he's a local aristocrat who lacks common sense. He doesn't know how to take it easy. As the second son of an aristocrat, he is loved by his family and friends, and while he is regarded as a master of magic in the magic guild, he becomes an 'Immortal Mage' behind the scenes.

81ad5c89-2a52-4642-bc7d-3aaa1fc6710c.description: At the age of eighty-eight, a lone master swordsman who had never known defeat was drawing his final breath. What this aging warrior sought to the very end was the "Truth of the Sword." Yet the ultimate truth slipped through his grasp as his vision faded to black, plunging him into the abyss. But when he opened his eyes once more, he was greeted by blinding light, and... twin peaks!
